data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add format_ticket_id(id, mode=None) to ticket-lib.sh. Makes T8-pre tests pass.

Implementation:
- When mode is None: read ticket.display_mode from .claude/dso-config.conf (default: canonical)
- Mode canonical: return 16-hex ID as-is
- Mode alias: read data.alias from ticket's CREATE event; if absent (pre-migration ticket), fall back to canonical
- Mode short: return shortest unambiguous prefix >= 4 chars; if ambiguous, fall back to canonical
- Unrecognized mode: fall back to canonical (no error, no stderr)

Register in ticket-lib-api.sh dispatch table under subcommand 'format'.

depends_on: T8-pre (385c-ec85)
Story DD coverage: SC5 (display cascade config)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: GREEN: implement format_ticket_id() and display cascade in ticket-lib.sh
